caption: The drawing depicts a metal object with a symmetrical, upright structure colored in grayscale tones. The central component is a cylindrical body with a domed lid on top, supported by a turned, spindle-like stem that flares out into a wide, circular base. Attached to the main body on either side are two smaller cylindrical units with flat tops and slightly flared bottoms, each mounted on a short horizontal extension. The object rests on a circular tray or plate that serves as its base. In the lower right corner of the composition, there is an inset technical sketch in a smaller frame, showing a simplified line diagram of the main object with labeled dimensions: the width spanning 5 inches and the height measuring 8 1/4 inches. The drawing is composed on a light, slightly yellowed background, and all elements are rendered in black and gray pencil with careful shading to indicate form and surface.
